chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Salih ibn al-Sindi, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Aban, from Umar ibn Yazid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I do not think a man increases in goodness in this matter (Wilayah) except that he also increases in his love for women.

key_terms.حُبًّا لِلنِّسَاءِ: Love for women — here denoting wholesome affection for family, wives, and daughters
key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: This matter — a Shia technical term referring to the Wilayah (guardianship/devotion) of the Imams

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the relationship between faith (Wilayah) and love for women?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms a spiritual correlation between a believer's growth in Wilayah — devotion and loyalty to the Ahlulbayt — and an increase in his natural affection for women. This hadith, narrated in the context of al-Kafi's chapter on love for women, frames the capacity for tender familial love as a sign of spiritual advancement rather than a worldly distraction. The original audience would have understood this as affirming that refined faith enhances all natural human faculties, including compassion and love within family bonds.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Salih Bin Al Sandy, from Ja’far Bin basher, from Aban, from Umar Bin Yazeed,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Iasws don’t think a man can increase goodness in this matter (Wilayah) except if he increases (his) love for the women’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Salih al-Sindiy from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Aban from ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
I do not think anyone increases goodness in this issue (belief in the Divine Authority of ‘A’immah) without his increasing love for women.’”
